milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate to the oak planks building and look toward the brown carpet placed at spawn-relative position (7, 0, 7). The brown carpet is inside the building, so the player needs to enter through the doorway and face the carpet on the floor. max_distance=5 ensures the player is inside or at the doorway of the building, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward the carpet.
